description: This file implements CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) functions, specifically CRC16 variants, for data integrity. It includes functions to compute CRCs with different initial values and to append CRCs to data buffers, used within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: Crc16
methods.description: Computes CRC16 checksum with specified initial value and inversion option.

methods.name: Crc16A
methods.description: Computes CRC16 checksum with initial value 0x6363 without inversion.

methods.name: Crc16B
methods.description: Computes CRC16 checksum with initial value 0xFFFF with inversion.

methods.name: WithCrc16A
methods.description: Appends CRC16 (variant A) to the input data buffer.

methods.name: WithCrc16B
methods.description: Appends CRC16 (variant B) to the input data buffer.
